response.text: I have enough to write up the notes. Two journals are unbalanced and one invoice's paid status disagrees with its payments, so I'll quickly identify those records.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbal' k, "JRNL_NO" j, SUM("DR_AMT")::text dr, SUM("CR_AMT")::text cr FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT") UNION ALL SELECT 'stat_mismatch', i."INV_ID", i."STAT_CD", COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0)::text || ' vs ' || i."INV_AMT"::text FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING (i."STAT_CD"='P') <> (COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) >= i."INV_AMT");
